purpose: One finite physical transport test for v=p*u, distinguishing nonsmooth multipliers from coalescence controls. No asymptotic or independence claim.
source_domain: All odd positive u <= 2^18; ordinary-source counts obtained by exact dyadic lifts
image_bound: p*cutoff; do not restrict images to the source cutoff
certificate: Every odd part of each registered source and image must have a checked Syracuse path to1. A repeated non1 state or >10000 uncached steps yields unknown, not no-hit, and fails complete claim.
validation: Independent direct Syracuse traversal of every unique registered odd starting state, using repeated halving rather than bit valuation, agrees with memoized target masks; paired basins disjoint; p=2 masks exactly agree with source masks; source totals agree with U03 complete catalogue.
measures: physical odd transfer count and fraction within base basin
p/eta divided by1+log n, for comparison only
joint versus product of finite marginals, explicitly non-iid
interpretable_positive_result: Positive finite transfer fraction shows an admissible finite map only; does not provide uniform eta or H.
interpretable_negative_result: Zero transfers at this cutoff does not imply an asymptotic no-go.
resources: Local CPU only; no GPU, paid resource, SSH or external code execution.
